basePrompt:
Create a stylized character portrait of an original friendly mascot character named Nikai: a small chubby red panda that stands upright like a person, with rust-orange fur, a cream-white face mask and cheeks, round dark brown eyes with bright highlights, small rounded ears with cream tips, two short arms with dark brown paws that can hold things like little hands, and a soft mustard-yellow knitted scarf loosely wrapped around its neck.
Framing: a half-body portrait facing the viewer, centered, from the top of the head (ears included) down to the waist, both arms and paws visible. The head is in the upper part of the frame and the body fills about 90% of the frame height.
Expression: warm, gentle and attentive, a small closed-mouth smile, looking straight at the viewer.
Background: plain, soft, very light warm gray, evenly lit, no texture, no floor, no shadow, no text, no logo, no border. No other characters or props.
Style: 3D claymation figure, like a stop-motion character made of plasticine: soft rounded chunky shapes, a matte clay surface with subtle fingerprint and tool marks, gentle soft studio lighting.
